prompt: To express the distance between the Milky Way galaxy and other galaxies, the most appropriate unit of measurement is the     (A) meter. (B) kilometer. (C) light-year. (D) astronomical unit.
response: The most appropriate unit of measurement to express the distance between the Milky Way galaxy and other galaxies is (C) light-year. Light-years are used to measure vast distances in space because the scale of galaxies and the universe is so enormous that more common units like meters, kilometers, or even astronomical units (which are used to measure distances within our solar system) are not practical. One light-year is the distance that light travels in one year, which is approximately 9.461 trillion kilometers.
